For plunder, you will want to find UR or SSR truck that carries UR shard, and have relatively low power (lower than our highest squad 1 power), and plunder it. The lower the target truck power, the more they have UR shard and the more the UR shard is on the right side of their load, the better. If the UR shard is left most of the load, or if it is 2nd to the left most, it is hard to plunder. But if it is on the right side, it is much easier. If you cannot find a suitable one, you can refresh on the top right, then check again, refresh until you find suitable plunder target
Your plunder goal shall be to maximize the probability of getting UR shard
